title: Nonparametric Subgraph Regression
abstract: arXiv:2611.07240v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Estimation and inference on a single large network are challenging due to dependence among observations. This paper studies nonparametric regression for outcomes defined on groups of $p$ agents, such as the indicator that three agents in a network form a triangle. Outcomes on groups that share an agent may be dependent, while outcomes on disjoint groups are independent. I call this problem subgraph regression; it nests dyadic regression as the special case $p=2$. Its leading application concerns subgraphs of a network, but the methods apply to any outcome defined on groups of agents. I establish a variance bound, uniform convergence rates in probability, and pointwise asymptotic normality for the subgraph analogue of the Nadaraya-Watson kernel regression estimator. translated_abstract: 由于观测值之间存在依赖性，对单个大型网络进行估计和推断具有挑战性。本文研究了定义在 $p$ 个主体群组上的结果的非参数回归，例如网络中三个主体是否形成三角形的指示变量。共享某个主体的群组上的结果可能是相关的，而不相交群组上的结果则是独立的。我将这一问题称为子图回归；它将二元回归作为 $p=2$ 的特例包含在内。其最主要的应用涉及网络的子图，但这些方法适用于任何定义在主体群组上的结果。我为 Nadaraya-Watson 核回归估计量的子图版本建立了方差界、概率上的一致收敛速度以及逐点渐近正态性。该设定与使用独立同分布数据的回归在两个方面不同：(i) 数量级为 $N^p$ 的观测数量高估了有效样本量，后者实际为 $N$；(ii)（摘要内容在此处似乎被截断）
tldr: 本文提出了“子图回归”这一新框架，用于对网络中定义在 $p$ 个主体群组上的结果进行非参数回归，并针对这种依赖数据结构为 Nadaraya-Watson 核估计量建立了方差界、一致收敛速度和渐近正态性，同时指出有效样本量为 $N$ 而非表面上数量级为 $N^p$ 的观测数。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "subgraph regression," a framework for nonparametric regression of outcomes defined on groups of $p$ agents in a network, establishing variance bounds, uniform convergence rates, and pointwise asymptotic normality for the Nadaraya-Watson kernel estimator, while showing that the effective sample size is $N$ rather than the nominal $N^p$ observations.
